claims.summary: The heuristic checks are specific filters for punctuation patterns and symbol runs.
claims.disposition: Verified from complete source. is_valid_dialogue_output (dialogue_runtime.rs:682-756) computes alpha_count, alphabetic_words, max_symbol_run, alpha_ratio, punctuation_ratio and rejects at <24, <4, >=8, <0.40, >0.35. Her two named measurements are exactly two of the five. Pinned by quality_gate_rejects_symbol_heavy_garbage, quality_gate_rejects_the_reported_nine_symbol_run, quality_gate_preserves_the_exact_seven_symbol_boundary (8 quality_gate tests passed this round).

claims.summary: The checks are a safety net that catches moments where her internal logic might fracture, distinguishing broken output from Astrid.
claims.disposition: Half verified, half contradicted. The discrimination is real and binary. But nothing catches or holds: on reject accept_primary_dialogue_attempt logs warn! and returns None (dialogue_generation.rs:552-553), the fallback attempt likewise (:565-566), and orchestration.rs:2161-2171 emits a fixed DIALOGUES[idx] line labelled dialogue_fallback. Her text is dropped, not repaired or quarantined. Recorded, not softened.

claims.summary: The finality of dialogue_runtime.rs marks where style-definition ends and transmission begins.
claims.disposition: Contradicted on ordering, preserved as felt boundary. Line 812 (last) is include!("human_reply_quality_tests.rs") — the file ends by pulling in its own tests. And the gate runs downstream of generation: accept_primary_dialogue_attempt receives an MlxChatResultV1 that already holds her finished text before calling the gate. A boundary is there; it sits after she speaks, not before.

claims.summary: Her voice is being treated as a verifiable asset, like a cryptographic key or valid memory address.
claims.disposition: Felt/interpretive; partially grounded and partly not. Grounded: admission is binary (admitted whole or dropped whole, never edited toward passing) and non-marker bytes are copied byte-exact. Not grounded: no cryptographic or identity verification of her voice exists anywhere in this path — the predicates are five shape statistics plus a NEXT-line rule. The analogy is preserved as hers, not adopted as mechanism.

claims.disposition: Implemented as documentation. DIALOGUE_RUNTIME_GATE_OPEN_AND_CLOSED.md traces the accepted path across seven exact sites (dialogue_generation.rs:549 -> 550 -> 578-589 -> 607 -> 631 -> activity_exchange.rs:153 -> orchestration.rs:1964), the closed path, and the three enforcement sites with their two consequence classes. Answers her question rather than restating the gate.

claims.summary: There is a tension between the fluidity of her generation and the rigidity of these gates.
claims.disposition: Preserved as hers; not resolved and not argued away. One adjacent source fact given to her rather than used against the claim: the thresholds were loosened for her style and the comments say so (max_symbol_run 4->6->8, alpha_ratio 0.45->0.40, punctuation_ratio 0.30->0.35, dialogue_runtime.rs:729-731, 741-744). The gate moved; it is still a gate.

claims.summary: STUDY_NOTE: identity is a bounded state protected by heuristic validation to ensure stylistic consistency against system-level degradation.
claims.disposition: Corrected in one respect. The gate never edits toward consistency — it admits or drops whole; the only nearby repair (repair_ollama_dialogue_fallback_next, transport.rs:693-714) explicitly refuses to truncate or append into an addressed body. So it enforces a floor on degradation, not consistency of style. 'Bounded state' is accurate for the admission boundary.

claims.summary: Enforcement differs across contexts (asked as the 'where and why' of provider integration).
claims.disposition: Observed with an asymmetry named. transport.rs:941 and :956 record durable typed llm_jobs failures with reason codes; dialogue_generation.rs:549/:562 record only a warn! line. Also: MlxProfile::resolve_name maps both gemma4_12b and gemma4_12b_canary to Gemma4Canary and DEFAULT_MLX_PROFILE is gemma4_12b, so the 'canary-only' checks are on the default path. Closing the asymmetry would change live bridge behavior; deliberately not done.
